title: Pasta Pomodoro
description: This pasta pomodoro is an easy and light pasta dish with a fresh tomato, garlic, and basil sauce for a flavorful dinner in just 30 minutes.
ingredients: freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente; drain.

Meanwhile, pour olive oil in a large deep skillet over high-heat. Add onions and garlic; cook and stir until softened and lightly browned. Reduce heat to medium-high and add tomatoes, vinegar, and chicken broth; simmer for about 8 minutes.
Stir in red pepper, black pepper, basil and cooked pasta, tossing thoroughly with sauce. Simmer until pasta is heated through and serve topped with grated cheese.

video.description: Check out this great recipe for Pasta Pomodoro, a simple and delicious Italian classic. In this video, we'll guide you through each step, from cooking the angel hair pasta to simmering the flavorful tomato sauce, all in just 30 minutes. Learn how to create this easy weeknight meal with fresh ingredients like roma tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, basil, and Parmesan cheese.
